inference_mode: single-request synchronous, one stream per variant
limitations: OpenVINO's NNCF INT8_SYM compression is not identical to TorchAO weight-only INT8.
OpenVINO's compiled inference uses a fixed CPU thread count and FP32 hint; compiler and kernel optimizations differ from PyTorch.
PyTorch .pt and OpenVINO IR artifacts have different serialization formats.
RSS is process-wide, not weights-only or peak inference memory.
Each model uses identical HANS inputs and batch size; tokenizer, loading, conversion, and compilation are excluded from throughput timing.
One seed and small subsets are exploratory; verify full 30000 examples across all seeds.
